sentences.text: The skull of Khoratosuchus features secondary choanae positioned relatively posteriorly and a smooth dorsal surface.
The genus Khoratosuchus was described by Lauprasert and colleagues in 2009.
Khoratosuchus is classified as a neosuchian crocodylomorph.
Khoratosuchus lived in northeast Thailand between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically the Aptian stage.
